item.title: The Rounded Glass Box
item.description:
Once upon a time, A Phoenix saw a throng gathered in a swamp; Curious, the Phoenix flew down to investigate. She discovered men, women, and children; all standing in line To see and converse with The Man in the Rounded Glass Box.

The Box was a strange attraction, so translucent and round; The Man inside even more strange, for he refused to ever leave it. A kind, helpful man: he bore the wisdom of a well-traveled soul, Yet he never spoke of what lives he’d led before. He would chat and give counsel, But all that truly mattered to him was that he stayed inside the Glass Box, For its what kept him safe, he claimed.
